title: Aether II Enhanced
description: A lightweight Aether II modpack focused on performance and quality of life improvements. Enjoy the classic sky dimension with smoother gameplay, better FPS, and small enhancements that don’t change the core experience.
body:
Aether II Enhanced Modpack improves the classic Aether II experience with performance and quality-of-life upgrades. It keeps the original sky-world adventure intact while adding FPS boosts and optimization mods to make the game run smoother on more systems!

This was mostly something i made because i was bored, so dont expect it to be that great.
